description: A single breath of vaporised DMT-analog. Ten thousand years in four hundred seconds.

events.text: [trip]The room peels away like wet paper and you fall UP through it.[/trip]
[trip]The machine-elves are showing you something. It's the most important thing there is.[/trip]
[trip]You have been here before. You have always been here. You live here.[/trip]
[trip]The cathedral begins, very gently, to fold you back up and post you home.[/trip]

overdose.message: You are shown the whole of it at once, and you weren't built to hold the whole of it.

phases.end_message: Four hundred seconds, by the clock. You will be arguing with that clock for a while.

effects.take_line: You take a single breath of {name}.

name: The Threshold
